name: edgar_financial_ratios
description:
Financial ratios for one fiscal period (default: latest reported fiscal year) from a company's us-gaap XBRL facts (EDGAR companyfacts): the period's own values, not prior-year comparatives.
Returns {cik, entityName, fiscal_year, fiscal_period, profitability_ratios {gross_margin, operating_margin, net_margin, return_on_assets, return_on_equity} (%), liquidity_ratios {current_ratio, quick_ratio, cash_ratio}, solvency_ratios {debt_to_equity, debt_to_assets, equity_multiplier}}; ratios lacking an input are omitted; debt = total liabilities.
Inputs (* required): cik*, fiscal_year (2009-2030), fiscal_period (default FY).
Raw numbers: edgar_company_concept.
Example: {"cik": "0000320193", "fiscal_year": 2023}

fiscal_period.description: Fiscal period (FY for full year, Q1-Q4 for quarters)

metadata.author: Ashutosh Sinha
metadata.note: Automatically calculates key financial ratios from XBRL data. Saves time compared to manual calculation.

profitability.gross_margin: Gross profit as % of revenue - measures production efficiency
profitability.operating_margin: Operating income as % of revenue - measures operational efficiency
profitability.net_margin: Net income as % of revenue - bottom-line profitability
profitability.return_on_assets: Net income as % of assets - how well assets generate profit
profitability.return_on_equity: Net income as % of equity - return to shareholders

liquidity.current_ratio: Current assets / current liabilities - ability to pay short-term debts
liquidity.quick_ratio: (Current assets - inventory) / current liabilities - stricter liquidity test
liquidity.cash_ratio: Cash / current liabilities - most conservative liquidity measure

solvency.debt_to_assets: Total liabilities / assets - portion of assets financed by debt
